changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'reporting' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Global_Resource') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [reporting].[Global_Resource]( [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [FirstName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [LastName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Email] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [IsAdministrator] [bit] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_ReportingGlobalResource_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [LastLoggedInOn] [datetime] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ReportingGlobalResource] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ResourceID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterDelete] ON [reporting].[Global_Resource] FOR DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
delete Asset where Object = 'Resource' and ObjectID in (select ResourceID from deleted); END

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [reporting].[ReportingGlobalResource_AfterUpsert] ON [reporting].[Global_Resource] FOR INSERT, UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
merge dbo.Asset as T using ( SELECT T.ID as AssetTypeID, 1 as [State], O.ResourceID as SourceID, 'Resource' as Object, O.ResourceID as ObjectID, O.[uid] FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'ResourceType' and T.ObjectID = 1 ) as S on (T.Object = S.Object and T.ObjectID = S.ObjectID) when matched then update set T.[uid] = S.[uid], T.UpdatedOn = getutcdate(), T.UpdatedBy = 0 when not matched by target then insert ([AssetTypeID], [State], SourceID, [Object], [ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy],[uid]) values (S.[AssetTypeID], S.[State], S.SourceID, S.[Object], S.[ObjectID], getutcdate(), 0, getutcdate(), 0, S.[uid]); END
